title: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
title_zh: 复用、重写还是拒绝：面向重复移动 GUI 控制的证据约束轨迹复用

paragraphs.en: Mobile GUI agents frequently perform repetitive tasks with similar interaction procedures. Reusing previous executions can reduce redundant LLM inference and execution overhead, but variations in user instructions and execution environments may invalidate previously successful actions. We systematically characterize these variations into six representative categories and observe that such changes do not necessarily invalidate entire procedures: individual transitions can remain reusable when validated against the current task context and interface state.
paragraphs.zh: 移动 GUI 智能体经常执行具有相似交互流程的重复性任务。 复用先前的执行可以减少冗余的 LLM 推理和执行开销，但用户指令和执行环境的变化可能使先前成功的动作失效。 我们将这些变化系统地归纳为六个代表性类别，并观察到此类变化不一定会使整个流程失效：在针对当前任务上下文和界面状态进行验证后，单个转移仍可保持可复用性。

sents.en: Mobile GUI agents frequently perform repetitive tasks with similar interaction procedures.
sents.zh: 移动 GUI 智能体经常执行具有相似交互流程的重复性任务。

paragraphs.en: Based on this insight, we propose graph–text templates for selective execution-trace reuse. The graph captures UI states and action transitions, while the text encodes task intent, procedural structure, and typed slots for variable content. A record–template–replay framework constructs templates from verified executions and leverages the current instruction and live UI state to reuse, adapt, or discard individual transitions. Given an execution trace, our framework reduces LLM inference token consumption by approximately 80% on average across five base agents on AndroidWorld, with most agents achieving at least 1.5 × \times execution speedup over LLM-only execution. In real-device evaluations on Android and HarmonyOS, our framework achieves action reuse ratios of 70.7–79.8% while maintaining over 2 × \times execution speedup in most evaluated configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一洞察，我们提出了用于选择性执行轨迹复用的图–文本模板。 图捕获UI状态与动作转移，而文本编码任务意图、流程结构以及用于可变内容的类型化槽位。 记录–模板–重放框架从经过验证的执行中构建模板，并利用当前指令和实时UI状态来复用、调整或丢弃各个动作转移。 给定一条执行轨迹，我们的框架在 AndroidWorld 上使五个基础智能体的LLM推理token消耗平均降低约80%，且大多数智能体相比纯LLM执行实现了至少1.5 × \times的执行加速。 在 Android 和 HarmonyOS 的真机评测中，我们的框架实现了70.7–79.8%的动作复用率，同时在大多数评测配置中保持了超过2 × \times的执行加速。

paragraphs.en: A central goal for mobile GUI agents is to become faster as they accumulate experience. In everyday use, an agent repeatedly encounters familiar tasks and interaction patterns, creating opportunities to reuse what it has already learned from execution. An agent that invokes a large language model (LLM) before every action continues to pay for decisions it has successfully made before. Turning previous executions into reusable experience can reduce these repeated model calls and user waiting time. The question is how to sustain this benefit as task conditions change.
paragraphs.zh: 移动 GUI 智能体的一个核心目标，是随着经验积累而变得更快。 在日常使用中，智能体会反复遇到熟悉的任务和交互模式，这为复用它已从执行中学到的内容创造了机会。 在每次执行动作前都调用大语言模型（LLM）的智能体，会为它曾经成功做出过的决策持续付出代价。 将先前的执行转化为可复用的经验，可以减少这些重复的模型调用和用户的等待时间。 问题的难点在于，当任务条件发生变化时，如何持续保持这一收益。

paragraphs.en: Two obstacles remain: changes in the environment and instruction. Even when the request remains the same, the application may be in a different state, its interface may have changed, or a dialog may interrupt the expected workflow. Conversely, a familiar interface may receive a request with a different value, target, or wording. These changes can make a previously successful action unnecessary, inappropriate, or insufficient for the current task. Repeated use therefore requires an agent to determine which parts of its experience remain useful under the current conditions. Addressing these two sources of variation is central to making experience translate into faster execution.
paragraphs.zh: 仍有两个障碍：环境的变化和指令的变化。 即使请求保持不变，应用程序可能处于不同的状态，其界面可能已经改变，或者一个对话框可能打断预期的工作流程。 相反，熟悉的界面可能收到一个值、目标或措辞不同的请求。 这些变化可能使先前成功的动作对当前任务来说变得不必要、不合适或不充分。 因此，重复使用要求智能体确定其经验的哪些部分在当前条件下仍然有用。 解决这两个变化来源是将经验转化为更快执行的关键。

paragraphs.en: We organize these obstacles into six main categories. Environment changes comprise background-state changes, layout and workflow changes, and modal interruptions; instruction changes comprise parameter changes, entity substitutions, and goal-expression changes. This categorization guides our analysis of when historical steps can be retained, need adaptation, or should be abandoned. We introduce their implications for reuse in Section 3 and develop the detailed case analysis in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这些障碍归纳为六大类别。 环境变化包括背景状态变化、布局与工作流变化，以及模态中断；指令变化包括参数变化、实体替换，以及目标表述变化。 这一分类为我们的分析提供指导，即历史步骤何时可以保留、何时需要调整、何时应当放弃。 我们在第 3 节中介绍这些类别对复用的启示，并在第 4 节中展开详细的案例分析。

paragraphs.en: MobiMem regenerates variable-step actions when parameters change, while SkillDroid and PreAct execute parameterized skills or programs ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Li, 2026 ) . We instead organize reuse around candidate transitions in a unified graph–text template: semantic descriptions retrieve executable structure, local annotations expose replaceable content, and live evidence determines whether each transition is reused, rewritten, or rejected. Each admitted transition is further guarded by pre- and post-action evidence checks, with rejected or failed steps falling back to the base agent.
paragraphs.zh: 当参数发生变化时，MobiMem 会重新生成可变步长的动作，而 SkillDroid 和 PreAct 则执行参数化的技能或程序 ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Li, 2026 ) 。 我们则围绕统一图—文本模板中的候选转移来组织复用：语义描述用于检索可执行结构，局部标注暴露可替换内容，实时证据决定每个转移是被复用、重写还是被拒绝。 每个被接纳的转移还进一步受动作前与动作后证据检查的保护，被拒绝或失败的步骤会回退到基础智能体。

paragraphs.en: We propose an evidence-constrained record–template–replay framework. During recording, the agent stores each action with its target and checked before-and-after states (Figure 1 ). The add-to-cart example links the selected item and quantity to the resulting cart state. Template extraction then preserves reusable procedure structure, exposes variable content as typed slots, and retains incompatible paths as separate branches. The resulting graph–text template integrates a capability description for semantic retrieval with executable UI transitions. Within the same template, local annotations mark entities and values that can be rebound to the current request, allowing applicable parts of a recorded procedure to be reused while changed steps are rewritten. During replay, the current instruction and live interface determine whether a candidate transition can be reused, rewritten with an explicitly supplied value, or rejected. Each admitted transition undergoes a pre-check, one-step execution, and a post-check; insufficient evidence or a failed check returns control to the same base agent. The controller thus reuses applicable steps while adapting to or recovering from changes elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一种证据约束的记录–模板–回放框架。 在记录阶段，智能体会存储每个动作及其目标对象和操作前后被校验的状态（图 1）。 以加入购物车为例，该框架将所选商品和数量与 resulting 的购物车状态关联起来。 随后，模板提取保留可复用的流程结构，将可变内容暴露为带类型的槽位，并把不兼容的路径保留为独立的分支。 由此得到的图–文本模板将用于语义检索的能力描述与可执行的 UI 迁移整合在一起。 在同一模板内，局部标注会标记可重新绑定到当前请求的实体和值，从而允许复用已记录流程中适用的部分，同时对发生变化的步骤进行改写。 在回放阶段，当前指令和实时界面决定一个候选迁移是可以复用、用显式提供的值进行改写，还是被拒绝。 每个被接受的迁移都要经过预检查、单步执行和后检查；证据不足或检查失败时，控制权会交还给同一个基础智能体。 因此，该控制器在复用适用步骤的同时，能够适应或从其他地方的变更中恢复。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate the framework on AndroidWorld, which provides reproducible mobile tasks with parameterized initialization and programmatic outcome checks ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) . Across five base agents, we measure task success, executed reuse, token consumption, LLM calls, and execution time. Given a verified execution record, our framework achieves 82.0–87.5% executed reuse and 1.2–1.9 × \times execution-time speedup. These tests establish a basis for assessing repeated execution, while comparison with practical phone use highlights differences in devices, operating systems, interface languages, and operating conditions. Although AndroidWorld supports variation in task parameters and initial states, its benchmark setting alone cannot establish how reuse performs across these real-use conditions. This motivates extending the evaluation to physical devices.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在 AndroidWorld 上评估该框架，该平台提供了具有参数化初始化和程序化结果检查的可复现移动任务（Rawles et al., 2025）。 在五个基础智能体上，我们测量任务成功率、已执行复用、token 消耗、大语言模型调用次数和执行时间。 在给定已验证执行记录的情况下，我们的框架实现了 82.0–87.5% 的已执行复用和 1.2–1.9 \times 倍的执行时间加速。 这些测试为评估重复执行奠定了基础，而与实际手机使用的对比则凸显了在设备、操作系统、界面语言和运行条件方面的差异。 尽管 AndroidWorld 支持任务参数和初始状态的变化，但仅凭其基准测试设置无法确定复用在上述真实使用条件下表现如何。 这促使我们将评估扩展到物理设备上。

paragraphs.en: We therefore conduct real-device evaluations on OnePlus 13, OPPO Find X8, Redmi K50, and Huawei Pura 80, spanning Android and HarmonyOS. Building on the six-category analysis, the quantitative studies focus on three representative conditions: background-state changes, parameter changes, and paraphrased instructions. These conditions examine whether the controller can account for a changed state, bind a newly requested value, and retrieve a familiar procedure under different wording. We report task success and execution efficiency, with component ablations examining state rechecking, value binding, and semantic retrieval. Across these conditions, our framework achieves 1.8–3.9 × \times execution-time speedup. Together, these studies examine repeated-execution efficiency and the mechanisms needed to reuse experience under environment and instruction changes.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们在 OnePlus 13、OPPO Find X8、Redmi K50 和 Huawei Pura 80 上进行了真机评估，涵盖 Android 和鸿蒙系统。 在六类分析的基础上，定量研究聚焦于三种代表性条件：后台状态变化、参数变化和改写后的指令。 这些条件考察控制器能否应对已变化的状态、绑定新请求的值，以及在不同措辞下检索熟悉的流程。 我们报告任务成功率和执行效率，并通过组件消融实验考察状态复核、值绑定和语义检索。 在这些条件下，我们的框架实现了 1.8–3.9 × \times 的执行时间加速。 这些研究共同考察了重复执行的效率，以及在环境和指令变化下复用经验所需的机制。

sents.en: These conditions examine whether the controller can account for a changed state, bind a newly requested value, and retrieve a familiar procedure under different wording.

sents.en: We report task success and execution efficiency, with component ablations examining state rechecking, value binding, and semantic retrieval.
sents.zh: 我们报告任务成功率和执行效率，并通过组件消融实验考察状态复核、值绑定和语义检索。

sents.en: Across these conditions, our framework achieves 1.8–3.9 × \times execution-time speedup.
sents.zh: 在这些条件下，我们的框架实现了 1.8–3.9 × \times 的执行时间加速。

sents.en: Together, these studies examine repeated-execution efficiency and the mechanisms needed to reuse experience under environment and instruction changes.
sents.zh: 这些研究共同考察了重复执行的效率，以及在环境和指令变化下复用经验所需的机制。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we analyze environment and instruction changes as two central obstacles to faster repeated GUI execution and organize them into six main categories of variation. Second, we develop graph–text transition templates and evidence-constrained selective replay to retain applicable actions, adapt explicitly bound values, and return control to the base agent when reuse is unsupported. Third, we combine AndroidWorld evaluation with experiments on four phone models spanning Android and HarmonyOS, measuring execution efficiency and task outcomes and using targeted ablations to examine adaptation to state, parameter, and wording changes.

paragraphs.en: GUI Agents for Mobile. AutoDroid and AppAgent support mobile automation through app knowledge or demonstrations, while UI-TARS integrates perception and action modeling ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Qin et al., 2025 ) . For efficient execution with smaller models, AutoDroid-V2 generates scripts from app documentation, Ferret-UI Lite develops compact policies, MobileExplorer overlaps inference with exploration, and UI-KOBE constrains runtime decisions through app graphs ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Chai et al., 2026 ) . These approaches address model and planning costs through complementary mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: Memory and Skill Learning for GUI Agents. Agent Workflow Memory, Agent S, and LearnAct organize workflows, experience, or demonstrations to support subsequent execution, with Agent Workflow Memory also offering an executable action-space variant ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Agashe et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . UI-Mem, MementoGUI, and MMSkills further use hierarchical experience or multimodal memory and procedures ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Executable skill construction takes several forms: callable APIs in SkillWeaver, recursive parameterized skills in SCAFFOLD, and state-machine memory or execution graphs in ActionEngine and CUA-Skill ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) . WebXSkill and SGDR pair executable skills with text for context-aware retrieval ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . EvoSkill-GUI, KnowAct-GUIClaw, and online skill evolution maintain and revise persistent procedures ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ; Hu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: GUI智能体的记忆与技能学习。 Agent Workflow Memory、Agent S 和 LearnAct 通过组织工作流、经验或演示来支持后续执行，其中 Agent Workflow Memory 还提供了可执行动作空间的变体（Wang et al., 2025b；Agashe et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026b）。 UI-Mem、MementoGUI 和 MMSkills 进一步利用分层经验或多模态记忆与流程（Xiao et al., 2026；Zeng et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026）。 可执行技能的构建有多种形式：SkillWeaver 中的可调用 API、SCAFFOLD 中的递归参数化技能，以及 ActionEngine 和 CUA-Skill 中的状态机记忆或执行图（Zheng et al., 2025；He et al., 2026；Zhong et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026c）。 WebXSkill 和 SGDR 将可执行技能与文本配对，用于上下文感知检索（Wang et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026a）。 EvoSkill-GUI、KnowAct-GUIClaw 和在线技能演化负责维护和修订持久化的流程（Chen et al., 2026a；Li et al., 2026b；Hu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Trace Replay for GUI Agents. V2S and GPA derive replayable procedures from recordings or demonstrations ( Havranek et al., 2021 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) . Mobile-Agent-E and AppAgentX learn executable shortcuts, while AgentRR adds experience abstractions with precondition and parameter checks ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) . MobileGPT, MobiAgent, and MobiMem use structured memories to reuse subtasks or local actions: MobileGPT adapts parameters and UI attributes with model-assisted parameter filling, MobiAgent combines action caching with UI-change detection, and MobiMem reuses prefixes and suffixes around steps requiring fresh reasoning ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . Executable Agentic Memory uses a lightweight value model for graph search, whereas MemoryPlayback uses confidence to switch between replay and VLM reasoning ( Qin et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2027 ) . PreAct, SkillDroid, and EchoPath combine parameterized replay with execution checks and agent fallback or repair ( Li, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) . SkillDroid checks state at each step and skips satisfied steps; its semantic matching invokes an LLM for confirmation and slot extraction. Selective replay, parameter adaptation, and fallback are therefore established capabilities. The comparison concerns admission/rewrite evidence under changed intent and state, and its acquisition cost.
paragraphs.zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的轨迹回放。 V2S 与 GPA 从录制或演示中推导可回放的流程（Havranek et al., 2021；Zhao et al., 2026b）。 Mobile-Agent-E 与 AppAgentX 学习可执行的快捷方式，而 AgentRR 增加了带前置条件与参数检查的经验抽象（Wang et al., 2025a；Jiang et al., 2025；Feng et al., 2025）。 MobileGPT、MobiAgent 与 MobiMem 使用结构化记忆来复用子任务或局部动作：MobileGPT 借助模型辅助的参数填充来调整参数与 UI 属性，MobiAgent 将动作缓存与 UI 变化检测相结合，MobiMem 则围绕需要重新推理的步骤复用前缀与后缀（Lee et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025a；Liu et al., 2025）。 可执行智能体记忆使用轻量级价值模型进行图搜索，而 MemoryPlayback 则依据置信度在回放与 VLM 推理之间切换（Qin et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2027）。 PreAct、SkillDroid 与 EchoPath 将参数化回放与执行检查以及智能体回退或修复相结合（Li, 2026；Chen et al., 2026b；Zhao et al., 2026a）。 SkillDroid 在每一步检查状态并跳过已满足的步骤；其语义匹配会调用 LLM 进行确认与槽位抽取。 因此，选择性回放、参数适配与回退已是成熟能力。 本对比关注的是在意图与状态发生变化时的准入/重写证据，以及获取该证据的成本。

VeriSafe Agent checks actions against formalized user intent, while SenseAct uses typed control primitives and programmatic postconditions ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . AppAgent-Claw validates outcomes after execution ( Song et al., 2026 ) ; ReUseIt , ContractSkill, and SKILL.nb combine pre/postcondition checks with local recovery in reusable workflows or skills ( Liu et al., 2026c ; Lu et al., 2026 ; El Hattami et al., 2026 ) . These approaches address action validity and outcome correctness, informing comparisons of pre-reuse checks and post-action verification.
paragraphs.zh: 面向图形界面智能体的动作验证。 VeriSafe Agent 根据形式化的用户意图检查动作，而 SenseAct 使用带类型的控制原语和程序化的后置条件（Lee et al., 2025; Cai et al., 2026）。 AppAgent-Claw 在执行后验证结果（Song et al., 2026）；ReUseIt、ContractSkill 和 SKILL.nb 在可复用的工作流或技能中结合前置/后置条件检查与本地恢复（Liu et al., 2026c; Lu et al., 2026; El Hattami et al., 2026）。 这些方法关注动作有效性与结果正确性，为比较复用前检查与动作后验证提供了参考。

AndroidWorld and MobileWorld evaluate mobile task execution, while MemGUI-Bench targets memory-dependent tasks ( Rawles et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . Final task success alone can obscure incorrect reused actions repaired by subsequent recovery, motivating analysis of local replay decisions alongside overall success and execution cost.

paragraphs.en: We study evidence-constrained transition reuse under changing instructions and UI states, using graph–text contracts to select reuse, rewriting, or rejection with fallback to the same base agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究在指令与UI状态变化下的证据约束转换复用，利用图–文本契约来选择复用、重写或拒绝，并回退到同一个基础智能体。

paragraphs.en: To make repeated mobile tasks faster, the controller must replace selected LLM calls without replaying actions that have become stale. Both the execution environment and instruction can change. We separate memory formation from memory use: the record phase captures evidence from an execution, template extraction turns that evidence into a reusable graph–text procedure, and the replay phase admits one transition at a time under live checks. The resulting decision is reuse , rewrite , or reject ; rejection or a failed postcheck returns control to the fallback policy.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让重复的移动任务执行得更快，控制器必须替换部分选定的 LLM 调用，而不重放已经过时的动作。 执行环境和指令都可能发生变化。 我们将记忆的形成与记忆的使用分开：记录阶段从一次执行中捕获证据，模板提取将这些证据转化为可复用的图-文本流程，而重放阶段在实时检查下每次只接受一个状态转移。 由此产生的决策是复用、重写或拒绝；拒绝或后检查失败会将控制权交还给回退策略。

paragraphs.en: Environment and instruction changes. Historical actions can become invalid under an unchanged instruction. Background state and TOCTOU may make a goal true at check time but false at action time, so duplicate or inverse actions are suppressed and the state is checked again before execution. Layout and workflow drift may move a target or change the required path; semantic relocation can handle the former, while the latter requires fallback. Overlays and interruptions can block the underlying page; only separately verified benign overlays are handled locally, whereas permission, login, payment, and task-relevant dialogs remain blocking states. These changes usually invalidate individual transitions rather than entire trajectories. The same environment can receive a different request. Parametric changes in quantity, time, or amount can be rewritten only when the live instruction supplies a matching typed slot. Entity changes require re-grounding products, contacts, or places in the current UI. Paraphrase and reference changes can share a canonical procedure when their intent is supported; an under-specified preference reference is rejected rather than silently filled. Instruction changes allow constrained local rewriting, not implicit replacement of critical values.

paragraphs.en: Recording transition evidence. During record , the fallback agent completes the task normally while the system stores the evidence needed for later decisions: the observable state before and after each action, the action and its target, the procedure step, any typed value, and the resulting progress or completion signal. Failed terminal outcomes are not stored as successful demonstrations; a prefix is retained only when its truncation point and state evidence are explicit.

paragraphs.en: Extracting reusable templates. Template extraction consolidates recorded transitions into a graph–text representation. Compatible observable states and actions are merged, while conflicting states remain separate branches. Values that may change across instructions are represented as typed slots; stable navigation and progress structure are kept as reusable edges. Transitions with missing evidence, an ungroundable target, or a failed terminal outcome are excluded from the released template. An “ideal” template is as reusable as the record supports without hard-coding incidental state.

paragraphs.en: Guarded selective replay. During replay , the current instruction and live UI select a candidate edge from the template. Figure 2 illustrates this process for a request to order two milk teas: the text procedure identifies the intent and quantity slot, UI-graph retrieval finds a compatible candidate, and live grounding checks its target and execution conditions. These retrieval checks identify a candidate; execution additionally requires evidence that its action remains valid for the current task.

paragraphs.en: Specifically, the candidate’s procedure step must agree with the current instruction, and its source-state conditions and target selector must be supported by the live UI. If the required value or target cannot be established, it emits reject even when the navigation context matches. High-risk entity/value pairs require stronger evidence and cannot be filled from preference alone. Figure 3 (left) summarizes the checks and decisions.

paragraphs.en: For an admitted edge, the controller refreshes the required evidence in a pre-check, executes the action once if the check passes, and performs a semantic post-check. The post-check must confirm the expected state change or completion predicate using the current slot bindings; a page change alone is not sufficient for every action. A failed post-check blocks the edge for the current episode and returns control to the fallback policy, preventing one mismatch from propagating through a trajectory. The right panel of Figure 3 shows how a rejected edge remains unexecuted while fallback produces a new observation for realignment. Each subsequent transition is rechecked before execution.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether historical experience can support reliable and efficient repeated mobile execution. We report success and efficiency on AndroidWorld and on real phones under background-state changes, parameter changes, and paraphrased instructions. Three real-device ablations examine how to preserve valid actions, adapt values, and retrieve procedures across paraphrases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估历史经验能否支持可靠且高效的重复移动端执行。 我们在 AndroidWorld 以及真实手机上报告了在后台状态变化、参数变化和指令改写情况下的成功率与效率。 三项真实设备消融实验考察了如何保留有效动作、适配参数值，并在指令改写时检索操作流程。

paragraphs.en: AndroidWorld is a widely adopted benchmark for online mobile GUI agents. Its original suite contains 116 tasks across 20 Android applications, with parameterized task initialization and programmatic success evaluation ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) . We evaluate our replay-assisted pipeline with GUI-Owl-7B, MAI-UI-8B, GELab-Zero-4B-preview, AutoGLM-Phone-9B-Multilingual, and UI-TARS-1.5-7B. For each base agent, successful LLM-only executions supply the records used to construct its template graphs. Record and replay tasks are similar, with some pairs differing in task details or parameter values to test reuse and rewriting; each candidate action is checked against the live instruction and interface, with the same base agent handling fallback. paragraphs.en: Real-device evaluation is essential for understanding how reduced LLM inference translates into practical execution speedups across devices and operating systems. Our timing measurements on AndroidWorld show that pre-action preparation and post-action state acquisition together can even account for 40.02% of total execution time. The benchmark protocol involves repeated UI-structure acquisition during these stages, reducing the fraction of runtime spent on LLM inference and thereby limiting the overall speedup achievable by avoiding model calls. This helps explain the comparatively modest speedups on AndroidWorld despite substantial reductions in LLM calls. We therefore extend our evaluation to four phone models spanning Android and HarmonyOS, optimizing UI-structure acquisition and reducing its frequency to lower observation overhead. This increases the fraction of runtime that can benefit from trace reuse, allowing us to assess its acceleration benefits alongside robustness to changes in device state and user instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 真机评估对于理解减少大语言模型推理如何在跨设备与跨操作系统场景下转化为实际的执行加速至关重要。 我们在 AndroidWorld 上的计时测量表明，动作前准备与动作后状态获取两者合计甚至可占总执行时间的 40.02%。 该基准测试协议在这些阶段会重复进行 UI 结构获取，降低了运行时中用于大语言模型推理的占比，从而限制了通过避免模型调用所能获得的整体加速。 这有助于解释尽管大语言模型调用大幅减少，但在 AndroidWorld 上加速幅度却相对有限的原因。 因此，我们将评估扩展到涵盖 Android 和鸿蒙系统的四款手机机型，优化 UI 结构获取并降低其频率，以减少观测开销。 这提高了运行时中可受益于轨迹复用的占比，使我们能够在评估其对设备状态与用户指令变化的鲁棒性的同时，评估其加速收益。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate record–live task pairs on physical Android and HarmonyOS phones. Each case compares replay only, two cumulative component additions, and the full controller under similar live instructions, initial states, and completion criteria. paragraphs.en: Direct comparisons with closely related reuse systems are constrained by implementation availability and differences in evaluation protocols. At the time of our artifact review, we could not locate publicly accessible official implementations of SkillDroid, EchoPath, or EAM ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Qin et al., 2026 ) . For MobiMem, MobiAgent, and AgentRR, we have not established a complete evaluation pipeline matching our record–live protocol from the available artifacts ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Feng et al., 2025 ) . PreAct’s controlled AndroidWorld replay experiments focus on a 15-task subset, limiting coverage and making the reported results potentially sensitive to task selection ( Li, 2026 ) . MobileGPT’s custom benchmark comprises 80 high-level tasks across eight apps, and its public implementation omits Random Explorer and human-in-the-loop memory repair, although the latter was also disabled in its original comparative evaluation ( Lee et al., 2024 ) . Accordingly, we present externally reported results as contextual references and use within-system ablations to examine component contributions under our evaluation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 由于实现可用性受限以及评估协议存在差异，与密切相关复用系统的直接比较受到限制。 在我们的工件评审时，我们未能找到 SkillDroid、EchoPath 或 EAM 可公开访问的官方实现（Chen et al., 2026b; Zhao et al., 2026a; Qin et al., 2026）。 对于 MobiMem、MobiAgent 和 AgentRR，我们无法基于现有工件建立与我们的“记录—实时”协议相匹配的完整评估流程（Liu et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025a; Feng et al., 2025）。 PreAct 的受控 AndroidWorld 回放实验仅聚焦于 15 个任务的子集，覆盖率有限，且报告的结果可能对任务选择较为敏感（Li, 2026）。 MobileGPT 的自定义基准包含跨八个应用的 80 个高层任务，其公开实现省略了随机探索器和人在回路的记忆修复，尽管后者在其原始对比评估中也被禁用（Lee et al., 2024）。 因此，我们将外部报告的结果作为背景参考，并使用系统内部消融实验来检验各组件在我们的评估协议下的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Given verified execution records, our results support selective trace reuse as a way to reduce repeated model inference and execution time in the evaluated settings. The framework combines applicable transitions, local rewriting of explicitly bound values, and fallback to the base agent within the same execution. This allows useful parts of prior experience to remain available as instructions and UI states change, with each reused action checked against current conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 在已验证的执行记录基础上，我们的结果支持在所评估的设置中选择性重用轨迹，以减少重复的模型推理和执行时间。 该框架在同一执行过程中结合了可应用的转换、对显式绑定值的局部重写，以及回退到基础智能体的机制。 这使得先前经验中有用的部分能够在指令和界面状态变化时仍然可用，同时每个被重用的操作都会根据当前条件进行校验。

paragraphs.en: Experience can accelerate repeated mobile GUI execution when reusable procedure structure is preserved and each action is reassessed under current conditions. We analyzed six categories of environment and instruction changes and developed a record–template–replay framework that captures verified executions as graph–text templates. By combining task intent with live UI evidence, the controller retains applicable transitions, rewrites explicitly specified values, and invokes the base agent when reuse is unsupported. Given a verified execution record, evaluation across five base agents yields 1.2–1.9 × \times execution-time speedup on AndroidWorld. In real-device evaluations on Android and HarmonyOS, our framework achieves action reuse ratios of 70.7–79.8% while maintaining 1.8–3.9 × \times execution-time speedup. Together, these findings support selective reuse as a means of translating past execution into fewer repeated model decisions and faster execution under changing task conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 当可复用的流程结构得以保留，且每个动作都在当前条件下被重新评估时，经验可以加速重复的移动 GUI 执行。 我们分析了六类环境与指令变化，并开发了一个“记录—模板—重放”框架，将经过验证的执行捕获为图—文本模板。 通过结合任务意图与实时的 UI 证据，控制器保留适用的转换、重写明确指定的值，并在不支持复用时调用基础智能体。 基于经过验证的执行记录，在五个基础智能体上的评估表明，在 AndroidWorld 上可获得 1.2–1.9 倍的执行时间加速。 在 Android 和鸿蒙系统的真机评估中，我们的框架实现了 70.7–79.8% 的动作复用率，同时保持 1.8–3.9 倍的执行时间加速。 这些发现共同表明，选择性复用能够将过去的执行转化为更少的重复模型决策，并在任务条件变化下实现更快的执行。

sents.zh: 其中，v i v_{i} 和 v j v_{j} 描述可观察的源状态与目标状态；a a 表示动作；g g 表示预期的程序步骤；k k 包含类型化槽位；s s 标识动作目标；r r 记录风险；ϕ − \phi^{-} 和 ϕ + \phi^{+} 表示动作前和动作后所需的证据。

sents.en: A successful episode supplies demonstration evidence; each transition also needs an identifiable local outcome.

sents.en: An explicitly verified prefix may be retained with its truncation boundary; a failed terminal action is not a successful demonstration.
sents.zh: 已被显式验证的前缀可连同其截断边界一起保留；失败的终止动作不构成成功示范。

paragraphs.en: Extraction preserves stable navigation and procedure structure while exposing changeable quantities, times, and entities as typed slots. Two observations can support a shared template edge only when their intended progress, relevant source-state conditions, action semantics, and checked outcomes are compatible. Visual resemblance alone does not justify merging. For example, settings pages with a toggle off or on may share navigation but require different action preconditions.
paragraphs.zh: 抽取在保持稳定的导航与流程结构的同时，将可变的数量、时间和实体暴露为带类型的槽位。 只有当两条观测记录的预期进展、相关源状态条件、动作语义以及所检查的结果都兼容时，它们才能共享同一条模板边。 仅凭视觉上的相似不足以作为合并的依据。 例如，开关处于关闭或开启状态的设置页面可能共享同一导航，但需要不同的动作前置条件。

paragraphs.en: Conflicting conditions remain separate branches. An edge that opens a product’s specification sheet cannot be replaced by one that directly adds the product to the cart unless the different preconditions and effects are represented. Source-record links preserve the evidence behind each branch. A transition with missing evidence, an ungroundable target, or a failed terminal outcome does not become an executable template edge merely because another record contains a similar instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 冲突的条件保持为独立的分支。 打开产品规格说明书的边，不能被直接把产品加入购物车的边所替代，除非不同的前置条件与效果已被表示出来。 源记录链接保留了每个分支背后的证据。 缺少证据、目标无法落地或终止结果失败的转移，不会仅仅因为另一条记录包含相似的指令就变成可执行的模板边。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval first identifies a procedure compatible with the live instruction and application context. The controller then checks candidate transitions against procedure progress and the current UI. Retrieval supplies candidates; a high similarity score does not itself authorize an action.
paragraphs.zh: 检索首先识别与实时指令和应用上下文兼容的程序。 控制器随后根据程序进度和当前 UI 检查候选转换。 检索提供候选；高相似度分数本身并不授权执行操作。

paragraphs.en: A slot binding connects a value in the live instruction to the action that uses it. A changed duration, for example, must update the duration-bearing action and the expected outcome. Navigation edges may remain reusable. Entity substitutions additionally require identifying the requested live product, contact, or location. An ambiguous reference does not justify silently importing a historical value.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位绑定将实时指令中的一个值连接到使用该值的动作。 例如，持续时间发生变化时，必须更新包含持续时间的动作以及预期结果。 导航边可以保持可复用。 实体替换还额外要求识别所请求的实时产品、联系人或位置。 引用存在歧义时，不能以此为由静默导入历史值。

paragraphs.en: Target grounding uses current observations to identify the control that implements the candidate action. A displaced control may remain usable if its semantics and state are supported. A missing control, conflicting identity, or blocking window instead requires rejection or fallback. The paraphrase comparison separately examines app-level semantic retrieval and soft task matching; the cumulative configurations are summarized in Section B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 目标定位（Target grounding）利用当前观察来确定实现候选动作所需的控件。 若被移位的控件的语义和状态仍受支持，则它可能仍然可用。 缺失的控件、冲突的标识或被遮挡的窗口则需要拒绝或回退。 改述对比分别考察应用级语义检索与软任务匹配；累积配置汇总于第 B.4 节。

sents.zh: 目标定位（Target grounding）利用当前观察来确定实现候选动作所需的控件。

paragraphs.en: Before execution, the controller refreshes the evidence needed by the selected edge and checks whether the goal is already satisfied. It emits reuse for a supported unchanged action, rewrite for a supported action whose typed payload is rebound, and reject when evidence is missing or contradictory. Rejection executes no GUI action; fallback follows it, not as a fourth decision.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行之前，控制器会刷新所选边所需的证据，并检查目标是否已经满足。 对于受支持且未发生变化的动作，它输出复用；对于受支持但其类型化载荷被重新绑定的动作，它输出重写；当证据缺失或矛盾时，它输出拒绝。 拒绝不会执行任何 GUI 操作；回退紧随其后发生，而不是作为第四种决策。

paragraphs.en: An admitted action executes once. Its postcheck verifies the expected semantic effect; a page change alone does not prove that a requested value or entity is correct. A failed postcheck blocks that edge for the current episode and returns control to the base agent. The next decision uses a fresh observation.
paragraphs.zh: 已获准的动作只执行一次。 其后置校验验证预期的语义效果；仅页面发生变化并不能证明所请求的值或实体是正确的。 后置校验失败会在当前回合中封锁该边，并将控制权交还给基础智能体。 下一次决策会使用全新的观察结果。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1: Guarded transition execution (method-level specification) 1. Input: live instruction q q , template memory ℳ \mathcal{M} , base policy π \pi , and episode budget. Initialize the episode’s blocked-edge set B = ∅ B=\emptyset . 2. Observe the live UI. If supported completion evidence satisfies q q , terminate successfully without an additional GUI action. 3. Retrieve a compatible candidate e ∉ B e\notin B ; bind its slots from q q and ground its target in the live UI. 4. Refresh required pre-action evidence. If the goal is now satisfied, terminate. If no candidate is admissible, record reject (or no candidate) and invoke π \pi from the current state. 5. Otherwise, emit reuse or rewrite , execute the admitted action once, and re-observe the UI. 6. Evaluate ϕ + \phi^{+} . On failure, add e e to B B and return control to π \pi . On success, update the observed procedure progress. 7. Re-observe after fallback as well. Continue from step 2 until verified completion, a terminal failure, or budget exhaustion.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1：受保护的迁移执行（方法级规范） 输入：实时指令 q q、模板记忆 ℳ \mathcal{M}、基础策略 π \pi 以及回合预算。 初始化该回合的被阻塞边集合 B = ∅ B=\emptyset。2. 观察实时 UI。 若已有受支持的完成证据满足 q q，则无需额外的 GUI 操作即成功终止。3. 检索一个兼容且 e ∉ B e\notin B 的候选；从 q q 绑定其槽位，并在实时 UI 中定位其目标。4. 刷新所需的动作前证据。 若目标此刻已满足，则终止。 若没有可采纳的候选，记录拒绝（或无候选）并从当前状态调用 π \pi。5. 否则，发出重用或重写，执行一次被采纳的动作，并重新观察 UI。6. 评估 ϕ + \phi^{+}。 若失败，将 e e 加入 B B，并将控制权交还给 π \pi。 若成功，更新已观察到的流程进度。7. 在回退之后同样重新观察。 从第 2 步继续，直到验证完成、出现终止性失败或预算耗尽。

paragraphs.en: AndroidWorld provides parameterized task initialization and programmatic completion checks. Its original suite contains 116 tasks across 20 applications; these numbers describe the benchmark rather than the evaluated subset for an individual model. Runs use English interfaces and instructions. Each base agent’s successful LLM-only executions supply the records for its template graphs, and assisted execution uses that agent as fallback. Record and live tasks are similar, with some pairs differing in task details or parameter values. The AndroidWorld success rate in Table 1 is computed as base success multiplied by the success rate conditional on records from successful base executions.
paragraphs.zh: AndroidWorld 提供参数化的任务初始化和程序化的完成检查。 其原始测试套件包含 20 个应用中的 116 个任务；这些数字描述的是该基准本身，而非针对单个模型评估所用的子集。 运行均使用英文界面和英文指令。 每个基础智能体仅在 LLM 下成功执行的结果为其模板图提供记录，而辅助执行则以该智能体作为回退。 记录任务与实时任务相似，但某些任务对在任务细节或参数值上有所不同。 表 1 中 AndroidWorld 的成功率按基础成功率乘以基于成功基础执行记录的条件成功率计算。

paragraphs.en: A record–live pair connects an earlier verified execution with a current request and device state. In the three quantitative conditions, background-state changes preserve the instruction while changing the current state, parameter changes modify a requested value, and paraphrases change wording while preserving intent. Within a comparison, the four configurations receive the same live instruction, initial state, and completion criterion. The real-device ablations use tasks designed to represent practical usage scenarios and executed on physical phones. The same designed task set is used across configurations, without selecting tasks on the basis of prior LLM-only success. Applications and representative task descriptions are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 记录–实时配对将早先已验证的执行与当前请求和设备状态连接起来。 在三个定量条件下，后台状态变化在改变当前状态的同时保留指令，参数变化修改所请求的值，而改写在保留意图的同时改变措辞。 在一次比较中，四种配置使用相同的实时指令、初始状态和完成标准。 真机消融实验使用旨在代表实际使用场景的任务，并在实体手机上执行。 同一设计的任务集在所有配置中使用，不会依据此前仅使用大语言模型的成功率来挑选任务。 应用及代表性任务描述见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: During real-device execution, an observer beside the phone judges whether the resulting object, value, and final state satisfy the live request. The observer evaluates outcomes without approving plans, correcting slot bindings, or selecting actions during execution. The completion boundary follows the requested task: adding an item to a cart or reaching an order page can be a terminal goal without completing a purchase. If execution crosses such a boundary and reaches a payment-password entry page, the observer terminates the process and marks the episode as a failure. This failure remains in the evaluated denominator. The same rule applies across compared configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 在真机执行过程中，观察者站在手机旁判断所产生的对象、数值和最终状态是否满足实时请求。 观察者只评估结果，而不批准计划、修正槽位绑定或在执行过程中选择动作。 完成边界以所请求的任务为准：向购物车添加商品或到达订单页面可以成为终止目标，而无需完成购买。 如果执行越过该边界并到达支付密码输入页面，观察者将终止该过程，并将该次回合标记为失败。 该失败仍计入被评估的分母之中。 同样的规则适用于所有被比较的配置。

paragraphs.en: Some task instructions contain account identifiers, travel details, or personal shopping and content preferences. paragraphs.en: The examples cover direct search, constrained product selection, date-conditioned information retrieval, creator lookup, and search within a store. A phrase such as “first result” is a selection instruction in the current interface; it is not a persistent identifier for a historical item. Likewise, “default configuration” refers to the selected live product’s options. Reuse must check the intended product or store and its current state before executing a stored action.
paragraphs.zh: 这些示例涵盖直接搜索、受限商品选择、基于日期的信息检索、创作者查找，以及在店铺内搜索。 「第一个结果」这类表述是当前界面中的选择指令，并不是某个历史条目的持久标识符。 同样，「默认配置」指的是当前已选商品在售状态的选项。 复用时必须先检查目标商品或店铺及其当前状态，再执行已存储的操作。

paragraphs.en: The live request explicitly asks for an additional unit. An existing cart entry therefore does not by itself satisfy the goal: the expected outcome is an increase by one in the requested product/configuration quantity. The cart’s first item must be checked against Smartphone A, and a changed selection state can invalidate an individual suffix transition. The instruction’s extra confirmation tap is a UI step, not a request to add another unit.
paragraphs.zh: 实时请求明确要求额外增加一个单位。 因此，已有的购物车条目本身并不能满足该目标：预期结果是所请求的产品/配置数量增加一。 必须将购物车的第一项与 Smartphone A 进行核对，且选择状态的改变可能使单个后缀转移失效。 指令中额外的确认点击是一个 UI 步骤，而不是添加另一个单位的请求。

paragraphs.en: For “Turn on dark mode,” the record begins with dark mode off while the live state already has it on. paragraphs.en: A record sets a 10-minute timer, whereas the live instruction requests a 15-minute timer from the same initial timer state. The duration changes while the procedure remains stable. Navigation can be reused, but duration entry and its expected effect use the live value. Table 4 specifies this illustrative transition. Shopping quantities and hotel dates provide other typed values in the task descriptions; their presence alone does not establish a controlled parameter-change experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 记录设定了一个 10 分钟的计时器，而实际指令在相同的初始计时器状态下要求设定 15 分钟的计时器。 时长发生了变化，而操作流程保持不变。 导航可以复用，但时长的输入及其预期效果使用实际值。 表 4 规定了这一示例性的状态转换。 购物数量和酒店日期在任务描述中提供了其他类型的值；它们的存在本身并不构成一个受控的参数变化实验。

paragraphs.en: Task success is the number of verified successful episodes n n divided by the number of evaluated eligible episodes N N . Failed actions, budget exhaustion, and human safety terminations contribute failures. Setup exclusions, if any, are distinct from failures within the evaluated set. For AndroidWorld record-conditional success, N N counts trials supported by records from successful base-agent executions, and n n counts successful trials within that set. In the real-world ablations, all configurations are evaluated on the same tasks designed for practical usage scenarios and executed on physical phones. The full configuration combines replay with model fallback; its success rate is not conditional on replay-only success. The ablation plots report these per-configuration success rates directly. paragraphs.en: AndroidWorld repeatedly acquires UI structures before and after actions, reducing the share of execution time spent on the LLM inference that replay can avoid. In the real-device implementation, we optimize UI-structure acquisition and reduce its frequency, increasing the fraction of runtime that benefits from inference savings. This distinction explains why large LLM-step reductions do not translate directly into equally large execution-time speedups. These ratios use the complete execution-time boundary and successful-pair aggregation defined above.
paragraphs.zh: AndroidWorld 在执行动作前后反复获取 UI 结构，从而减少了回放所能避免的那部分大语言模型（LLM）推理所占用的执行时间比例。 在真机实现中，我们优化了 UI 结构的获取并降低了其获取频率，提高了受益于推理节省的运行时占比。 这一区别解释了为什么 LLM 步骤的大幅减少并不能直接转化为同等幅度的执行时间加速。 这些比率使用了上文定义的完整执行时间边界和成功配对聚合方法。

paragraphs.en: The task descriptions use stable aliases within each example so that product, store, creator, and destination relationships remain understandable.
